title: Unknown CMake command "ament_target_dependencies" in ROS 2 Lyrical: the replacement that builds on every distro
excerpt: Lyrical removed ament_target_dependencies. Replace it with target_link_libraries(target PUBLIC rclcpp::rclcpp ${std_msgs_TARGETS}); tested on Humble, Jazzy, Kilted and Lyrical, plus the three ways the fix still fails.
